services.name: RadRunner 2 E-Bike
services.desc: Never stop exploring! Enjoy the 50+ miles of bike paths that Lake Tahoe has to offer on one of our top of the line, family-friendly, peddle assist Rad Power E-bikes. Our RadRunner 2 bikes are the perfect bike for cruising Tahoe. Whether you are hauling beach gear down the West Shore Trail to Sugar Pine Point State Park or Meeks Bay, exploring the Truckee River Trail to Squaw Valley, or going for a cruise down the world famous East Shore Trail from Incline Village to Sand Harbor with the whole family, the RadRunner 2 is the Ultimate E-bike to get the job done. services.name: Fishing Charters
services.desc: If you're looking to catch some delicious Lake Trout (AKA Mackinaw) in Lake Tahoe, look no further than our private fishing charters. Our 6-pack charter boats are specifically set up to target these game fish, making for an unforgettable fishing experience. You'll also get to take in the magnificent sights of Lake Tahoe along the way. Plus, with a friendly captain/guide, all the necessary gear and tackle, and fish filleting are provided. Please note that fishing licenses (not included) are required for anyone aged 16 and older who plans to fish. Licenses can be purchased by clicking here.
